+Default ``FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS`` setting changed from ``None`` to ``0o644``
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+Without a consistent umask, permissions for a file uploaded to
+``FileSystemStorage`` could be inconsistent depending on whether
+``MemoryUploadedFile`` or ``TemporaryUploadedFile`` was used for temporary
+storage of the uploaded data (which, with the default
+:setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_HANDLERS`, is determined by the uploaded data size).
+
+The new default makes permissions consistent regardless of the size of the
+uploaded file.
+
+If you want to retain the current behavior for existing files you can leave the
+:setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS` setting as ``None``, and manually update any
+files uploaded by your project.
+
